main_text.p: in foetum, comprobabit. {Nimirum, fae-penumero accidit ; (profitente ipsomet Illustrifs. Viro pag. 131.) ut vestigia rei desiderata infanti imprimantur, etiamsi illa corpus matris ne extremo quidem digito tangerit, vel in illud inciderit: sufficit, inquit, si quaedam res alia corpus gravida affiat, vel in partem ejus aliquam, dum ipsius modi appetitus in imaginatione illius nominatur, inopinato delabatur; (quin imo sufficit, si vel nulla res alia corpus gravidae fetiat, vel in partem ejus aliquam inopinato delabatur; sufficit, inquam, saepenumero res sola imaginatione apprehensa, eidemque pertinacius firmiusque impressa, utut vel ipsa universo illo Mundi climate non exsistat, ac mulier interim partem quamcunque corporis sui ex inopinato digitis contrectet, in qua adeo impressio spirituum conceptam ideam ferentium, forte figatur:) & statim rei ita defidera-ta figura postmodum in eadem corporis infantis parte, qualis quae primum illum in matre.

page.notes: Page is a Latin text page with a faint, partly illegible passage; the foot note above was not printed as such and should be disregarded. Several words in the lower lines are doubtful and may be misread.
